## Current Venture
Semi (https://trysemi.com) - Founder, 2026.
AI operations software for SMBs, service companies and enterprises in Costa Rica and Central America.
One system for the commercial operation (contacts, deals, quotes, tasks, inbox, collections and dashboard) with three AI features: customer service that always answers, one-click quotes, and automatic follow-up and collections. What the AI does not understand is routed to a person instead of guessed.
Built with Next.js, Supabase and Claude Code: 108 database migrations, 139 API endpoints and 108 test files. Pre-launch.

## Selected Case Studies
1. Anfiteatro de Villa: Five-layer operating system for an 800-capacity hospitality venue. Built in 12 weeks.
2. Financial services company: Performance evaluation platform for 1,000 employees. Hybrid 70/30 model (Oracle KPIs + 9-box evaluation).
3. Trade association: Sales transformation funnel for a national trade association. Executed in 18 days across 4 platforms.
